verses.text: Ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén yet' heb' yik Gad manhxo jantakok nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ayik ix yilan heb' to a lum skuchan Jazer yet' Galaad, te wach' lum yik smolji nok' nok',
ix b'at heb' yil winhaj Moisés yet' winhaj sakerdote Eleazar yet' pax heb' yajalil chonhab'. Ix yalan heb' icha tik t'a heb':

--Ilek wal lum makb'il yuj juntzanh chonhab' tik: Haton Atarot, Dibón, Jazer, Nimra, Hesbón, Eleale, Sebam, Nebo yet' Beón, te wach' swa masanil nok' molb'etzal nok' t'a juntzanh lum lum tik. Yuj skolwal Jehová ix kik'kanek' lu'um yik tz'ochkan lum kikok a onh israel onh tik. Eyojtakpaxi to ay juntzanh nok' nok' tik molb'il kuuj.
Yuj chi' tato wach' tze na'a, aq'ek juntzanh lum tik t'ayonh, yik max onh ek'kan t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --¿Tom he gana tzex kan t'a tik yakb'an sb'at heb' ketchonhab' t'a owal?
¿Tas yuj tzeyak' chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' ketchonhab' yik max ek' heb' t'a jun lum yalnak Jehová to ol yak' t'a heb'?
Icha wal tik yutej sb'a heb' ko mam kicham ayik in chekanb'at heb' yil lu'um ayik ayonhek' t'a Cades-barnea.
k'och heb' yil jun lu'um chi' masanto t'a sch'olanil ha' Escol. Slajwi chi' yak'an chab'axk'e sk'ol heb' ketisraelal heb' yik max och heb' t'a lum yak'nak sti' Jehová yak'an t'ayonh.
Yuj wal chi' kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a jun k'u chi', yuj chi' yak' sti' to

a heb' anima 20 ab'il sk'inal sb'eynhejb'ati ayik yelnakkot heb' t'a Egipto, manh ol yil-laj lum heb', lum yak'nak sti' yak'an t'a heb' yinhtilalkan winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Jacob, yujto manh smasanilok sk'ol heb' och tzak'an yuj tas yala'.
Anhej winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone yinhtilal winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun, ol och t'a lu'um, haton heb' winh k'anab'ajan t'a smasanil sk'ool tas yal Jehová chi'.
Kot yowal Jehová chi' t'ayonh, yuj chi' 40 ab'il onh ek' t'a tzinan lum yuj, masanto ix satel masanil heb' maj k'anab'ajani, manhxo junok heb' ix kani.
Ha exxo tik, ex yinhtilal anima pit, he gana tze b'eyb'alej sb'eyb'al heb' ko mam kicham chi' yik tze tzuntzanxikot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a kib'anh.
Tato malaj he gana tzex och tzak'an yuj Jehová chi', ol ex yaktejkan t'a jun tzinan lu'um tik yet' masanil jun chonhab' tik. Eyuuj wal ol onh satelok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.

Yuj chi', ix snitzanb'at sb'a heb' t'a stz'ey winhaj Moisés chi', ix yalan heb' icha tik: --Ha wal tas ko gana, to sko b'ok'e smakte' nok' ko kalnel yet' nok' ko wakax t'a tik yet' chonhab' yik heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' kuninal.

Ha onhxo tik ol kak' lista ko b'a t'a owal. Ol onh b'ab'laj t'a yichanh heb' ketchonhab' tik masanto ol yal kik'anb'at heb' t'a lum lum chi'. Axo heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' kuninal ol kan heb' t'a chonhab' ayoch smuroal tik t'a junk'olal, yik wach' malaj tas tz'utaj heb' yuj heb' anima kajan t'a juntzanh chonhab' tik.
Masanto ol yal skan heb' ketchonhab' tik t'a sat sluum ichato chi' ol onh meltzajxikot t'a ko pat tik.
Yujto a lum ay t'a jun k'axep tik kik tz'ajkan lu'um, haton t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u tik, yuj chi' ha t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán chi' manh ol ko chalaj lum ko lu'um chi' a onh tik, xchi heb'.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb': --Syal eyik'ankan lu'um tato tz'elk'och icha wal tas tzeyal chi', ol eyak'nhej owal icha syal Jehová.
Tato he masanil a ex tik eyet'nak eyamk'ab' yik owal ol ex ek' t'a ha' Jordán icha syal Jehová chi', tzex kannhej ta' masanto syal yel heb' ajk'ol chi' eyuuj.

Ayik toxo ix eyik'kanek' lum lum chi' yuj Jehová, ayik toxo pax ix ak'ji ganar heb' anima ta', ichato chi' ol ex meltzajok. Icha chi' ol aj he k'anab'ajan b'aj tzeyak' he ti' t'a Jehová yet' t'a heb' eyetchonhab' tik.
Palta tato max he k'ulej icha chi' jun, a wal ta' ol eyila' to ix och he mul t'a Jehová, ol k'och sk'ual ol yak'anoch yaelal t'a eyib'anh yuj he mul chi'.
B'oekk'e he chonhab' yuj heb' ix eyetb'eyum yet' heb' eyuninal, tze b'oan smakte' nok' he kalnel chi', tze k'anab'ajan masanil tas tzeyal chi', xchi winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb'.
Ix tak'wi heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén yet' heb' yinhtilalkan Gad icha tik: --Ha onh a chekab' onh tik, ol ko k'anab'ajej masanil tas ix al chi'.
Ha heb' ix ketb'eyum yet' heb' ko kotak unin yet' masanil nok' ko molb'etzal nok', ol kan t'a juntzanh chonhab' t'a Galaad tik.
Ha onhxo tik jun, ol onh b'at t'a owal b'aj ol yal sk'ol Jehová, icha wal alan chi', xchi heb'.
Ix yalan winhaj Moisés t'a winhaj sat sakerdote Eleazar yet' t'a winhaj Josué yuninal winhaj Nun yet' t'a masanil heb' yajalil chonhab' t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Israel icha tik:

--Tato masanil heb' winak t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' t'a yik Rubén lista yaj yak'an owal, ol ek' heb' eyet'ok t'a yol ha' Jordán icha yalan Jehová, masanto ol eyik' lum lum chi', ichato chi' tzeyak'an lum Galaad tik smakb'enok heb'.
Tato max b'at heb' t'a owal chi' eyet'ok jun, ha t'a lum Canaán chi' ol yik' smakb'en heb' eyet'ok, xchi winhaj Moisés chi'.
Ix tak'wixi heb' yinhtilalkan Gad yet' heb' yik Rubén chi' icha tik: --Ol ko k'ulejnhej masanil tastak schek Jehová ko k'ulej.
Ket'nak ko yamk'ab' yik owal ol onh ek' t'a Canaán chi' icha syal Jehová, palta kik tz'ajkan lum lum t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u tik, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi' ha t'a heb' yinhtilalkan Gad yet' t'a heb' yik Rubén yet' t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilalkan Manasés yuninal winhaj José, ix yak' lu'um winhaj Moisés chi', haton lum yik winhaj Sehón sreyal heb' amorreo, lum yik winhaj Og sreyal Basán yet' jantak chonhab' makb'il yuj yet' jantak smakb'en ay t'a spatiktak.
Axo heb' yinhtilalkan Gad ix laj sb'oxik'e chonhab' Dibón heb' yet' Atarot, Aroer,
Atarot-sofán, Jazer, Jogbeha,
Bet-nimra yet' Bet-arán. Ix yak'anoch smuroal heb', ix sb'oanpax smakte' skalnel heb'.
Axo pax heb' yinhtilalkan Rubén, ix sb'oxik'e chonhab' Hesbón heb', Eleale, Quiriataim,
Nebo, Baal-meón yet' Sibma. Ix sk'exan sb'i juntzanh chonhab' ix sb'oxik'e heb' chi'.
Axo pax heb' yinhtilal Maquir yuninal Manasés, ix ik'anpaxkan lum ay t'a Galaad. Ix yak' ganar heb' spechanel heb' amorreo ta'.
Icha chi' ix aj yak'an lum Galaad winhaj Moisés t'a heb' yinhtilal Maquir, yuj chi' ix kajnaj heb' ta'.
Axo pax winhaj Jair yinhtilalkan Manasés, ix yak' ganar juntzanh skampamento heb' amorreo heb', ix yak'an skuch heb' Havot-jair.
Axo jun winh skuchan Noba yet' juntzanhxo heb' ajun yet'ok, ix yak' ganar heb' aj Kenat heb' yet' juntzanhxo chonhab' ayoch t'a yol smakb'en. Ix yak'an winh skuch Noba.
